tasks.baseline_rationale: Rust's ownership and explicit error paths are the strongest available comparison for a region lifetime repair.

exclusions.python: No equivalent explicit ownership semantics prepared.
exclusions.typescript: No equivalent explicit ownership semantics prepared.
exclusions.ocaml: No equivalent region lifetime starter prepared.

acceptance_criteria: A failed allocation leaves live handles usable and does not collect a manual region.
An explicit collect changes the collection counter exactly once.
A handle cannot escape its closed region.

tasks.baseline_rationale: TypeScript has the closest mature typed package API and module graph for this API migration task.

exclusions.python: No equivalent typed API-index starter prepared.
exclusions.rust: No equivalent package API starter prepared.
exclusions.ocaml: No equivalent package API starter prepared.

acceptance_criteria: Update callers to the pinned public package API without changing unrelated modules.
Dependency and API resolution complete without missing-symbol diagnostics.
Existing behavior and declared error classes remain equivalent.

tasks.baseline_rationale: Rust's explicit unsafe FFI is the strongest applicable native C boundary baseline.

exclusions.python: Python extension boundary would add a different interpreter and ABI.
exclusions.typescript: No direct native ABI starter prepared.
exclusions.ocaml: No equivalent reviewed C binding starter prepared.

acceptance_criteria: Call the pinned fixed-shape C ABI only through an explicit unsafe boundary.
Reject a mismatched ABI version before invocation.
Preserve byte lengths, error codes, and release ownership on every path.

tasks.baseline_rationale: Python notebooks have the most established comparable cell state and comprehension workflow.

exclusions.rust: No equivalent interactive notebook starter prepared.
exclusions.typescript: No equivalent reviewed notebook starter prepared.

acceptance_criteria: Identify which cells become stale after a changed pure scalar definition.
Explain retained values without replaying earlier cells.
Give the same answers under a blinded rubric for both languages.

tasks.baseline_rationale: Rust with the same external bounded verifier is a conservative typed baseline for interpreting proof results.

exclusions.python: No matched contract verifier starter prepared.
exclusions.typescript: No matched contract verifier starter prepared.
exclusions.ocaml: No matched contract verifier starter prepared.

acceptance_criteria: Distinguish proved, disproved, and unknown outcomes with their assumptions.
Identify the source obligation and explain a concrete counterexample without asserting unproved safety.
Answer the behavior question under a blinded rubric.

tasks.baseline_rationale: Rust's checked integer operations provide the strongest comparable fixed-width arithmetic baseline.

exclusions.python: Unbounded integers need a separately reviewed fixed-width shim.
exclusions.typescript: Number semantics differ and no equivalent fixed-width starter is prepared.
exclusions.ocaml: No independently reviewed fixed-width starter prepared.

acceptance_criteria: Preserve exact i64 boundary behavior through a multi-module call chain.
Overflow returns the specified error class rather than a wrapped value.
Finite inputs produce equal outputs and error locations under equivalent starters.
